Choice C is a distractor: it doubles rather than exponentiates. Choice D is a distractor: it omits one input combination.
questions.hint: Each input doubles the number of rows.

questions.stem: For a quiz question, 6 - A circuit is built from 6 two-input AND gates, each fed by distinct external wires. How many external input wires are required?

options.misconception: it counts gates instead of their input wires
it adds two wires regardless of gate count

Choice B is a distractor: it counts gates instead of their input wires. Choice C is a distractor: it squares the gate count. Choice D is a distractor: it adds two wires regardless of gate count.
questions.hint: Two input wires per gate, all distinct.
